summary: Carded on the user's instruction at close-out: 'we will need to fix that silent drop off the LoRAS'. Surfaced by the GPU smoke matrix, where ops PASSED while their style LoRAs never loaded. The separator bug that triggered it is fixed; the silence is not, and any future cause reproduces it. Id claimed with exclusive mkdir per MPI-488.

note: Root cause confirmed READ-ONLY (no Pod, no app restart): ComfyUI validates per OUTPUT node and returns HTTP 200 {prompt_id, number, node_errors} whenever at least one output still validates (execution.py:1247 -> server.py:1132). The Pod wrapper passes that body through verbatim (JSONResponse(r.json())), so BOTH engines carry it. runWorkflow reads only ack.prompt_id and drops ack.node_errors - the invalid style-LoRA branch is skipped and the run resolves success. Owns js/services/comfyController.js + tests/prompt-partial-validation.test.cjs.

Fixed in js/services/comfyController.js: the 200 ack's node_errors is now read, logged, best-effort un-queued and thrown tagged with the EXISTING lora_missing_*/weights_missing_* codes, so commandExecutor's warning toasts fire with no new UI. Tags by ENGINE, not carrier - a 200 is structured node_errors on remote too (wrapper JSONResponse(r.json()) -> Express _passthrough, both verbatim, all hops read). Style slots are lora_1..lora_5 (MPI-359), so rejected input names are collected by shape; a ['lora_name'] reader matches none of the ten krea2 styles. Guard: tests/prompt-partial-validation.test.cjs drives the REAL runWorkflow, 7/7, and fails 'Missing expected rejection' in 3.8ms when the guard is removed. Full suite 519 pass 0 fail. NOT verified on a real engine (matrix owns the Pod, by instruction). Smoke runner has the identical blind spot at scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs:552 - not mine, filed to MPI-467 as a message.

Silent LoRA drop closed. ComfyUI validates per OUTPUT node and answers HTTP 200 {prompt_id, number, node_errors} whenever one output still validates (execution.py -> server.py); runWorkflow read only prompt_id, so an invalid style-LoRA branch was skipped and the run resolved success. comfyController now fails the generation on a non-empty node_errors, tagged with the EXISTING lora_missing_*/weights_missing_* codes so commandExecutor's toasts fire with no new UI, and tagged by ENGINE not carrier (a 200 is structured node_errors on remote too - wrapper JSONResponse(r.json()) and Express _passthrough both verbatim, all four hops read). Rejected input names collected by shape because MpiStyleLoras slots are lora_1..lora_5 (MPI-359), which a ['lora_name'] reader misses entirely. Guard tests/prompt-partial-validation.test.cjs drives the real runWorkflow, 7/7, fails 'Missing expected rejection' in 3.8ms with the guard removed; full suite 519 pass 0 fail. Durable fact landed in docs/comfy.md (the 400-body section, whose carrier-identifies-the-engine trap was scoped to 400 only). The identical blind spot in scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs was reported to MPI-467, who implemented and mutation-verified their own fix. NOT run on a real engine - the GPU matrix owned the Pod for the whole session, by instruction.
